summary: A park director wants to keep the property’s name and learns which feature the outside board can rename.
realLife: Lake Metroparks opposed a change in Ohio and staff explained that the federal proceeding could not rename the park itself.
inGame: needs: the park boundary, the feature on the docket and which authority controls each name.

turns.what: The clerk marks the feature on the map.
turns.pulledBy: The proposal concerns a natural feature.
turns.writesBack: The park name falls outside the motion.

turns.what: The director directs them to the park authority.
turns.pulledBy: Residents want the park renamed as well.
turns.writesBack: A separate local request can be filed.
